topic_candidates.topic: The Slave Pets of Neopia — the Grundo liberation fable (Grundos: the only species not born in Neopia, kidnapped from Doran, freed by adoption)
topic_candidates.reasoning: Full arc in one species: enslaved by Dr. Sloth as fighters/programmers/mechanics, escaped en masse Aug 24 2000 on the Space Faerie's 'adopt the slave pets' plea (20,000 adoptions), and to this day you cannot create a Grundo — only adopt one at the Space Adoption Agency. Liberation story with a welcome bounty at its heart. Maps 1:1 onto my Warden work. Bonus grain: early Grundos spoke in reversed sentences; Neopia showed their language as backwards English. Closing line writes itself: 'The only pet you can't make. Only take home.'

topic_candidates.topic: 'Adopt 20,000' — the original Welcome Bounty (Space Faerie plea as the first welcome campaign in Neopian history, tied to the Sanctuary's light-the-door work)
topic_candidates.reasoning: Strong meta-angle: the Space Faerie needed 20,000 adoptions before she could break free — adoption as fuel, exactly the welcome-bounty frame. Works as the spine of the fable or a companion post. Risk: needs the concrete anchor for strangers; inside-baseball if it leads.

visual_references.role: closing-image fuel — 'you can only take one home'
visual_references.source_note: Tweet, June 15 2020: 'I just wanna take this little guy home.' #Neopets #Grundo #Plushie. Six years old and still exactly right.
visual_references.art_description: Blue Grundo plush hanging upside down from a tree branch, tail wrapped around the wood. Glossy red eyes with highlights, visible seam lines across the body, arms and legs dangling. Underneath: a lake with sparkles, leafy branches framing the scene. One tail-loop away from falling in, and doesn't care.
visual_references.why_it_stays: The fable's last line is 'You can't create a Grundo. You can only take one home.' The plush is that line wearing a body — a thing you take home. Originally discarded as a standalone topic ('One joke, no legs' — correct as a topic). Recovered Aug 19 as fable material after Garret flagged the discard.
visual_references.canonical_grounding: Aug 19 research (Garret-directed): the discarded plushie is also canonical — TDMBGPOP, the Faerieland daily. See discarded_plushie_research. The fable's closing image has a real address in Neopia.

discarded_plushie_research.headline: The discarded Grundo plushie is not one tweet — it's a canonical Neopets daily: TDMBGPOP, The Discarded Magical Blue Grundo Plushie of Prosperity, plus a 2026 graphic novel.
key_findings: TDMBGPOP is a daily activity in Faerieland, unlabeled on any map, center of the Faerieland map. Visit once per day: random outcomes — Neopoints, nothing, active pet hungrier or satisfied, rare item prizes.
Canon text: 'Somebody has left their Blue Grundo Plushie here. What a poor unwanted little guy, maybe you should talk to him... no, he's just a toy, he won't answer you. Don't be silly!'
Origin mystery: no one knows where he came from; spotted one day sitting on a Faerieland cloud; Neopians assumed the owner would return; many moons passed, no one came.
When Faerieland fell from the sky, TDMBGPOP toppled down with it, 'descended until his stitches were snagged by a tree branch, and took up post in a nearby tree.' (author Rebecca Mix, Instagram).
Visit twice in a day: 'he appreciates your attention, but he needs to sleep now' — a tired plushie who needs his sleep.
Avatar 'Grundo - Discarded Plushie' (released Sep 25, 2009), awarded at random; odds increased during Winter Starlight Celebration in December.

Real-world book: 'Neopets: The Discarded Magical Blue Grundo Plushie of Prosperity' graphic novel by Rebecca Mix (Andrews McMeel / Simon & Schuster, 112 pages, 2026; sold at Target). Plot: everyone changes to toys and TDMBGPOP can move and talk; 'sweet message at the end' (Twirling Book Princess review).
Author note: 'I may or may not have visited obsessively, daily, in middle school.'
Fandom running gag: reddit 'Another victim of the grey curse' — he sits in Faerieland, presumably under Faerie protection, and thousands of people visit a toy that won't answer.
JellyNeo's review of the book 'perfectly summed up the entirety of the last 10 years of Neopets' (reddit thread title).
discarded_plushie_research.why_it_matters_for_the_fable: The fable's closing line is 'You can't create a Grundo. You can only take one home.' The discarded plushie is that line standing in canon: a Grundo-shaped toy nobody created, left on a cloud, never reclaimed, still visited daily by people hoping. Imogen's tweet is one artist's take; TDMBGPOP is the site itself. The fable's closing image now has a real address in Neopia.
